exposure: Resting interval after double-balloon cervical ripening removal
resting interval after removal of a double-balloon for cervical ripening and oxytocin administration
outcome: Time to onset of active labor
cohort: 403 singleton pregnancies requiring cervical ripening with a double-balloon between January 2019 and December 2022
finding: Oxytocin administration immediately after removal of a double-balloon for cervical ripening, compared with a 12-hour delayed interval, resulted in a shortened time from insertion to active labor onset and to delivery interval without increasing maternal or neonatal adverse outcomes.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean) was similar between groups assigned to immediate versus delayed oxytocin administration after cervical ripening with a double-balloon.
